description: Write a session's model to a file under the workspace root, as %save does: .sysml notation with comments preserved, or .ttl/.json RDF (experimental). A path outside the root is refused. Without apply nothing is written and the file's content, in the format the extension names, is returned as content.

apply.description: write the file; without it the bytes the file would hold (notation, Turtle or JSON by extension) are returned as content and nothing is touched

path.description: file to write, relative to the workspace root or absolute but under it: .sysml notation, or .ttl/.json RDF (experimental)

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: session_save

applied.description: whether the file was written; false for an empty session, which has nothing to save

content.description: without apply: the file's bytes, in the format the extension names

text.description: what %save printed: notes, warnings, and what was or would be saved
